ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface area with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters comprising the remaining 10%.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex mathematical curve sweeping from the central notch toward the distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a secondary, partially submerged low-intensity pixel mass located to the right of the primary fluke structure.
